historical_evidence.availability_time_basis: explicit publication clock when present; otherwise period_end + 60 days
historical_evidence.reason: the committed crisis dossiers do not preserve a complete public-availability/revision archive; a conservative filing lag prevents quarter-end lookahead but cannot reconstruct overwritten amendments

modes.description: Disclosed asset quality and capital only. Fires rarely and never cried wolf on a healthy control in the backtest; misses wholesale-funding blowups whose reported NPAs stayed clean.

Adds the wholesale funding-structure flag. Catches the DHFL-class failures the conservative mode misses, at a known false-alarm cost: healthy housing financiers run the same gearing levels as the ones that failed.

note: Gearing LEVEL does not separate failed from healthy HFCs (DHFL 9.3x vs LIC Housing 10.5x), so the sensitive mode's false alarms are structural, disclosed, and not tuned away. Numbers regenerate with the backtest artifacts.
